title: Zesty Crispy Malaysian Chicken Curry
description: A briny, crispy, and comforting Malaysian dish featuring panang-paste, perfect for a low-sodium diet, served in a bento-box. This recipe is a twist on traditional Malaysian curry with a crispy exterior and flavorful interior.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the panang curry paste, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and knead until the chicken is well coated with the curry mixture.
Dip each chicken piece in the cornstarch to coat, shaking off excess.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken pieces to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Mix the coconut milk and 1 tablespoon of water in a bowl.
Pour the coconut milk mixture over the chicken and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes.
